title: a16z Podcast: How to Pay for Healthcare Based on Health

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: There's been a lot of talk about the need for our healthcare system to shift away from volume and fee-for-service.
reader_summary.overview: There's been a lot of talk about the need for our healthcare system to shift away from volume and fee-for-service, where you pay by appointment, procedure. But there's also been a real dearth of seeing how that might work in action, or concrete models for how to implement it at scale. In this episode.

key_points.text: There's been a lot of talk about the need for our healthcare system to shift away from volume and fee-for-service.
